name: Focaccia
summary: Same-day dimpled slab. Crisp base, steamy interior.

steps.text: Mix in a bowl with wet hands. No kneading.
Three sets of folds, 40 minutes apart.
Oil the pan generously, stretch the dough to fill.
Rest until bubbly, dimple hard, salt, bake.

bake.notes: The pan should look over-oiled. That is what fries the base.

notes: Cold ferment overnight makes it better but it is fine same day.
